resources.string:
1. In TiviMate, go to Settings → Playback and set MX Player / external player, or long-press a channel or movie → "Play with" → choose AutoSub Player.

2. When you play something, AutoSub Player searches OpenSubtitles for English subtitles automatically (by title first, then by file hash) and shows them.

3. Basic controls: D-pad center = play/pause, left/right = seek. Your position is saved — reopen the same stream to resume.

4. You need a free OpenSubtitles API key below (sign up at opensubtitles.com, then API section). Adding your username/password raises the daily download limit.
